facts.fact: NJI Administrator Justice Adejumo described the Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023 as a vital legal framework in use, and the NDPC chief cited its section 50 on judicial review of Commission orders.
TheNigeriaLawyer reports the Nigeria Data Protection Commission under CEO Dr Vincent Olatunji acting as the statutory regulator.

NDPC chief Olatunji said the commission had issued over 20 major remediation orders, investigated more than 240 breach cases and named more than 1,900 non-compliant organisations, over about three years.
